description: This is a Java test class for the UserCreatedShelfService in a book management application, utilizing JUnit 5 and Mockito for unit testing.

classes.name: UserCreatedShelfServiceTest
classes.description: JUnit 5 test class for testing UserCreatedShelfService functionalities, including CRUD operations, search, and validation features.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by mocking dependencies and creating an instance of UserCreatedShelfService.

methods.name: findById_throwsException_ifIdIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that findById throws NullPointerException when called with null.

methods.name: canFindById
methods.description: Tests that findById correctly calls the repository to retrieve a shelf by ID.

methods.name: findAllForLoggedInUser
methods.description: Disabled test intended to verify retrieval of all shelves for the logged-in user.

methods.name: findByShelfNameAndLoggedInUser_throwsException_IfShelfNameIsNull
methods.description: Disabled test, checks that passing null as shelf name throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: save_throwsException_ifShelfIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that saving a null shelf throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: save_throws_whenNameExistsInPredefinedShelfNames
methods.description: Parameterized test verifying exception is thrown when shelf name conflicts with predefined shelf names.

methods.name: save_throws_whenNameExistsInPredefinedShelfNames_andContainsWhiteSpaces
methods.description: Parameterized test for white-space padded predefined shelf names, expecting IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: save_throws_whenUserCreatedShelfNameAlreadyExists
methods.description: Checks that attempting to save a shelf with an existing shelf name throws an exception.

methods.name: save_whenUserCreatedShelfNameNotExists
methods.description: Intended to verify successful save when shelf name does not exist, but currently misconfigured to always throw.

methods.name: canSaveNonNullCustomShelf
methods.description: Tests that a valid UserCreatedShelf is saved successfully.

methods.name: delete_throwsException_ifShelfIsNull
methods.description: Verification that deleting null shelf throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: canDeleteNonNullCustomShelf
methods.description: Tests that a valid UserCreatedShelf can be deleted successfully.

methods.name: canDeleteAll
methods.description: Tests that deleteAll invokes repository method properly.

methods.name: canCount
methods.description: Verifies that count method correctly invokes repository.

methods.name: canFindAll
methods.description: Checks that findAll fetches all shelves.

methods.name: findAll_searchesWithoutFilter_ifFilterIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that findAll defaults to fetch all shelves when no filter string is provided.

methods.name: findAll_searchesForFilter_ifFilterIsNotNull
methods.description: Verifies that findAll filters by shelf name when a non-null filter string is provided.

methods.name: getBooksInCustomShelf_throwsException_ifShelfNameIsNull
methods.description: Checks for NullPointerException when fetching books with null shelf name.

methods.name: getCustomShelByName_throwsException_ifShelfNameIsNull
methods.description: Checks that passing null to getCustomShelfByName throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: findOrCreate_throwsException_ifShelfNameIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that findOrCreate throws NullPointerException when shelf name is null.
